source: Published @composio/core 0.29.0 → local protocol twin. Synthetic data. Scripted callers; no live provider or LLM.

scenario.name: The response disappeared
scenario.description: The provider stores an event, then the TCP connection closes before the SDK receives a response. The unsafe caller retries; the guarded caller checks durable evidence.

timeline.detail: Published Composio SDK → loopback proxy · ca_demo

timeline.detail: /calendar/events · write 1

timeline.title: Response lost after commit
timeline.detail: TCP socket destroyed after storing the event. The client cannot infer the outcome.

timeline.title: Application retries the write
timeline.detail: Deliberately unsafe comparison policy; this is not SDK automatic retry behavior.

scenario.description: An agent reads v1. A human writes v2. An unconditional update overwrites the human; a conditional update using If-Match is rejected with 412.

scenario.description: The synthetic proxy returns a failure after storing the event. The outcome is resolved from a unique provider record, rather than interpreting an error as permission to retry.
